# Akshay Dahiya

> AI-native SEO specialist and growth marketer helping brands improve visibility across search engines, answer engines, and AI-powered discovery through technical SEO, GEO research, and data-driven marketing.

Akshay Dahiya is an AI-native SEO & Growth Marketing Specialist based in the United States, working across technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), SEM, and web development. This site includes independent GEO research (the GEO Retrieval Research Series) and resource hubs covering SEO/GEO tactics, strategy, and glossary terms.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://akshaydahiya.site/): Overview of services and expertise.
- [About](https://akshaydahiya.site/about-me.html): Background, expertise, and professional experience.
- [Whitepapers](https://akshaydahiya.site/whitepapers.html): The GEO Retrieval Research Series, independent research on AI citation behavior.
- [Contact](https://akshaydahiya.site/contact.html): Get in touch for SEO, GEO, SEM, or web development projects.

## GEO Retrieval Research Series

Independent research measuring how AI systems (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and others) retrieve, chunk, and cite web content.

- [001: Crawl Freshness vs AI Visibility](https://akshaydahiya.site/crawl-freshness-vs-ai-visibility-whitepaper.html)
- [002: Multi-Hop Citation Paths in AI Retrieval](https://akshaydahiya.site/multi-hop-citation-paths-whitepaper.html)
- [003: What AI Actually Reads on Your Webpage](https://akshaydahiya.site/what-ai-actually-reads-whitepaper.html)
- [004: How LLMs Recommend Local Businesses](https://akshaydahiya.site/how-llms-recommend-local-businesses-whitepaper.html)
- [005: Which Entity Types Increase Citation Probability?](https://akshaydahiya.site/entity-types-increase-citation-whitepaper.html)
- [006: Entity Density vs Citation Rate](https://akshaydahiya.site/entity-density-vs-citation-rate-whitepaper.html)
